note: ALT DATASETS (satellite / supply chain / patents), read by research/acquire_datasets.py after its seeds. Every row names its licence, whether it is keyless and machine-use-allowed, the MT5 instruments it informs and the mechanism. `fetch: false` rows are REGISTERED with the blocker that stops them, so the gap is a named row rather than an absence. Rows were written from the cloud container, whose proxy blocks these hosts: none is probed here; the acquirer probes on the box every hour and records SUCCESS or the refusal in data/acquired/registry.json. `{today}` in a URL is replaced with the UTC date (YYYYMMDD). Row shape (id, cadence, auth, licence, machine_use_allowed, cursor, region, language) matches the roster the MT5 global mining pipeline absorbs.
